Start
Make your home screen your own
A few steps to explore KeiHome and check what is ready. You can skip optional setup and return here from Settings.
Icons that fit together
Supported icons can follow light/dark mode and the applied theme across system surfaces. Extra packs and Monet are optional.
A more personal launcher
Customize Dock, appearance and labels, icons and launch screens.
Changes you control
Guide links open settings so you can choose resources and features. Previewing or editing a draft does not apply it; Monet has a separate on/off switch.
Check the module environment
KeiHome uses LSPosed API 102. Enable the module in your manager and grant the scopes needed by the features you use. You can continue even if setup is incomplete.
Framework service connected
Framework service not connected yet

First activation requires a full device reboot. Enable the module and grant the required scopes, then reboot. Unlock to the home screen and wait briefly. Opening or skipping this guide, or restarting KeiHome or the launcher, does not replace this step. API 102 automatic hot reload updates only the Java part. Updates that include new .so native code require a manual system restart.\n\nAfter reading the upgrade notes and returning to the main page, restart advice appears once per version. Its confirmation button becomes available after five seconds. Confirmation only acknowledges the advice; you restart the device manually.
Choose an icon style
Choose system icons, Perfect, Apple or an imported pack. Supported system surfaces can reuse the applied artwork; coverage depends on the host and app.
Supported system icons follow light/dark mode
Browse built-in styles, or use the floating import button for APK, MTZ or ZIP files. Follow the sheet to import into system Themes; automatic application follows your setting.

Choose a color source and scheme, preview both appearances, then tap Apply colors. Custom colors and palette details have their own pages. Applying keeps the current on/off state; use the switch separately.

ColorOS and Perfect can fill gaps in app coverage. Download any Perfect style first; HyperOS4 is recommended. Perfect completion pauses system fallback and restores your choice when turned off. Apps set to keep their original icons are excluded.
Compare original, HyperOS4 and custom masks on the same icons. With adaptation on, custom masks take priority; pack masks come next, then HyperOS4.
Preview, apply, then check
After changing icon resources or rules, update or regenerate as prompted, then apply the pack. Reapply after changing custom icons or kept originals. Previews alone do not update the applied theme.
Make optional adjustments

Browse desktop settings by category. Supported changes sync automatically; check their status on the corresponding page. Availability depends on your launcher and scope access. Opening a page keeps your settings unchanged.
Open desktop settings
Dock, appearance and labels, icons and launch screens.
Ready to explore
You have reached the end of the guide. Optional setup can be completed later, and this guide is always available in Settings.

Status shows the targets and launcher connection that were reported. Scope grants do not confirm that every host is loaded. Open the share sheet, Settings or Sidebar to check the icons you use; availability depends on the system version and app.
Module feature issues need LSPosed logs

For module issues affecting icons, Dock, notifications, sidebar or launcher performance, export LSPosed logs. App logs are only for KeiHome UI, settings or crashes, and require confirmation with a 20-second wait. Include screenshots and the full version and environment from About.
Open LSPosed for feature issues; use the floating export button for App issues
Review imported archive sizes and separate MTZ/ZIP, Apple and Perfect controls; the top cleanup action only frees preview memory
onboarding welcome first use setup guide

Choose a style, preview and adjust options such as light and dark appearance, then generate or update and apply the pack. Downloaded styles work offline. Check the notice at the top when changes need regeneration.
Choose iOS, iPadOS or macOS icons, check per-app mappings, then generate and apply. Searches and downloads reuse cached assets. Check the notice at the top when changes need regeneration.
Local icons and cache reuse

System surfaces reuse local theme images with a bounded memory cache; unsupported entries keep their original icons. Clearing preview memory preserves downloaded images and the applied pack.\n\nPerfect Icons sync and Apple search and downloads connect when you request them. If rate limited, wait for the countdown before retrying; repeated attempts do not shorten the wait.
Check the surfaces you use
Review access for installed targets; grants and actual loading are separate
Download selected styles and required shared resources; removal keeps resources other styles still need. Find styles with the top filter and sort menus.
Search by app or package name, then filter by scope and sort. Switching between a custom icon and a kept original requires confirmation. Regenerate and apply as prompted to use the changes.
The cleanup reminder defaults to 520 MB, regardless of Perfect downloads. App logs count toward cache usage; open their entry in Cache to view or export them. The reminder does not delete resources.
Choose system name matching, sharing between official Telegram channels and ColorOS Theme Store mappings as needed. Per-app custom icons and kept originals take priority over these mappings.
